title: Ulfina Kan Liqimse
intro: Mee kana yaadi: lubbuu uffata gaarii uffatte fi qabeenya yaadamuu hin dandeenyeen marfamte. Namni dhuunfaa kun qabeenyi isaanii qaroo ofii isaaniitiin akka argate kan amanu yoo ta’u, madda rizqii dhugaa gonkumaa hin beeku ture. Namni kun hordoftoota raajii jabaa tokko gidduutti osoo deemuu waamicha gad of deebisuu hunda ni dide. Har’a eenyummaa nama qabeenyi isaa inni guddaan bakka boqonnaa isaanii isa dhumaa ta’e tokkoo ifa goona.
clues: Bara raajii saba mata jabeessa dhugaatti waamu keessa jiraadhe.
Ani qaama hawaasa filatamaa ture, taʼus onneen koo ergaa sana irraa garagale.
Warqee fi meetiin ajaja waaqaa kamiyyuu caalaa na booji’e.
Kuusaan qabeenya koo baayʼee balʼaa waan dhufeef gareen dhiirotaa cimaan furtuu sana kaasuun rakkisaa taʼe.
Qabeenyi koo sababa beekumsa kootiin naaf kenname jedheen of jaje.
Dhumarratti aniifi manni jireenyaa koo guutuun akka akeekkachiisaatti lafaan liqimfamne.

arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فِى زِينَتِهِۦ ۖ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا يَـٰلَيْتَ لَنَا مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ قَـٰرُونُ إِنَّهُۥ لَذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍۢ
verse: So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, "Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qārūn. Indeed, he is one of great fortune." (28:79)
